title: Art. 13 — Article 13 - Arrangements by Carrier
content: If in the course of concluding the contract of carriage by air, Carrier also agrees to make arrangements for the provision of additional services, Carrier shall have no liability to the passenger except for negligence on its part in making such arrangements.
